selection.edition: international Nango Cloud REST API at api.nango.dev
selection.ownership: Nango Inc, United States. Privacy policy states Nango is based in the U.S. and stores data on US AWS. International cloud product at api.nango.dev; self-hosted enterprise is a different edition and is not this recipe.

research.searchCoverage: Official Nango Cloud HTTP API for Bearer environment keys, GET /providers, GET /providers/{provider}, GET /integrations, GET /connections, Nango Inc US identity, self-hosting as a separate edition, and dated incident search (Nango + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. The 2025-10-06 Nango Cloud outage was availability, not a customer-account compromise. No qualifying unresolved Nango platform compromise identified. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

research.edition: international Nango Cloud REST API at api.nango.dev
research.searchCoverage: Official Nango Cloud REST API is HTTPS to api.nango.dev with Authorization Bearer environment API keys. GET /providers is the documented catalog probe used by the pinned credential validator and is used as healthcheck. GET /providers/{provider}, GET /integrations, and GET /connections are documented reads. Writes, credential-bearing get-connection, and object tags query filters are omitted. Self-hosted Nango is a different edition; this recipe pins the documented cloud host. Operator is Nango Inc in the United States. Dated incident search on 2026-09-13 found no qualifying unresolved platform compromise. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.
research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: POST /action/trigger with Connection-Id and Provider-Config-Key headers and JSON action_name/input.
POST /connect/sessions. end_user is optional in the official API; tags are preferred. Success includes 201.
POST /connect/sessions/reconnect requires connection_id and integration_id.
POST /connections upserts a connection with existing credentials. credentials is a JSON object, not a string.
DELETE /connections/{{connection_id}}?provider_config_key=.
GET /connections/{{connection_id}} with required provider_config_key query. Returns credentials when the API key is permitted.
Optional connectionId, search, limit, page, endUserId, and endUserOrganizationId match documented query names. tags uses OpenAPI deepObject encoding as tags[key].
Covers Composio NANGO_LIST_CONNECTIONS and NANGO_CONNECTION_GET. Returns raw Nango JSON under data.
POST /connections/metadata replaces metadata. connection_id may be a string or an array.
PATCH /connections/metadata merges metadata. connection_id may be a string or an array.
PATCH /connections/{{connection_id}}?provider_config_key= with tags and optional deprecated end_user.
GET /environment-variables. Nango may return a JSON array; output data accepts array or object.
Credential-only healthcheck maps to documented GET /providers, matching the pinned credential validator.
Native category is dev-tools rather than Developer Tools/Data: Rust CATEGORIES has no data bucket.
Returns raw Nango JSON under data. Connection writes, get-connection credential dumps, and self-hosted hosts are omitted.
POST /integrations with provider, unique_key, optional display_name and credentials object.
DELETE /integrations/{{unique_key}}. Composio uniqueKey maps to unique_key.
GET /integrations/{{unique_key}} with optional include[]=webhook|credentials.
Maps to documented GET /integrations. include[] credential expansion is omitted.
Returns raw Nango JSON under data.
PATCH /integrations/{{unique_key}}. Composio new_unique_key maps to body unique_key.
provider is a required path segment on documented GET /providers/{provider} and is URL-encoded.
Returns raw Nango JSON under data.
GET /providers for NANGO_PROVIDERS_LIST_GET. Healthcheck keeps the same documented catalog probe. Returns raw Nango JSON under data.
GET /proxy/{{any_path}} with Connection-Id and Provider-Config-Key. Nested paths are URL-encoded. query_params become the query string. nango-proxy- prefixing of arbitrary headers is omitted.
PUT /proxy/{{any_path}} with JSON body. Nested paths are URL-encoded. Arbitrary additional_headers prefixing is omitted.
GET /scripts/config with optional format=nango|openai.
GET /sync/status with required provider_config_key and syncs query (comma-separated or *).
POST /sync/trigger. Official opts.reset/emptyCache are used instead of Composio sync_mode.
